analysis.reason: RSI 43.8에서 62.1로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 -0.5394에서 7.4519로 개선되며 상승 추세 강화. 5일 저가 514.80 대비 현재가 565.72는 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 거래량비 1.38로 움직임에 힘 실림.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 43.8 to 62.1, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -0.5394 to 7.4519, strengthening the uptrend. The 5-day low of $514.80 compared to the current price of $565.72 forms a Higher Low pattern. Volume ratio of 1.38 adds conviction to the move.

· 52주 위치(77.2%) + 현 가격대 역사적 고점 접근 구간
[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.5394→7.4519): 개선 지속, 강세 확산 신호
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $565.13 근처): 상단 접근 구간, 추가 상승 여력 확인

· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 매수 진입 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($565.72) vs SMA5 ($550.00)/SMA20 ($521.66)/SMA50 ($525.27): Confirms short- to mid-term uptrend position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($543.59)/SMA200 ($445.48): Maintains mid- to long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (77.2%) + Approaching historical high price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.8→62.1): Exited oversold, entered neutral zone, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.5394→7.4519): Continuous improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $565.13): Approaching upper band, indicating potential for further upside.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($536.12): Basis for Higher Low pattern formation relative to 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($566.02): Expectation of further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Signaling entry into recovery phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.38x): Increased confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met.
